_comment: EXAMPLE manifest.json — the canonical per-file CHECKSUM manifest (manifest.schema.json), placed at the UNIT ROOT. An entry per file the manifest covers, each with a real sha256 and byte count; verify_manifest checks exactly in both directions over the subtrees the entries span. Corpus document metadata (doc_date, form_type, ticker) lives in each corpus document and in task.json, NOT here: verify_manifest expects files[], and a documents[]-style corpus index in a file named manifest.json fails verification. Not authoritative: the shipped exemplar is units/t4-EXAMPLE-eps-beat/manifest.json.
notes: Replace every sha256/bytes with the real values. The embargo gate reads doc_date from each corpus document, not from this file.
